_comment: Reviewed, committed pins for the ONE-TIME Base Mainnet MPGRExecutorDelegated deployment (the UNIVERSAL delegated autonomous executor). This is a SEPARATE artifact from deploy-config.json (the v1 assisted executor 0xD982...505A) and a SEPARATE contract: v1 pulls tokens only from msg.sender and is structurally incapable of executing for a user, so it must NEVER be used for delegated autonomous execution. NOT YET DEPLOYED: mainnetDelegatedDeployEnabled is false, so script/DeployMPGRExecutorDelegatedBaseMainnet.s.sol refuses to run. To deploy, an operator must set it true in a reviewed commit AND set MPGR_MAINNET_DELEGATED_DEPLOY_ENABLED=true in the environment (two independent flags), use a fresh dedicated deployer key (nonce 0), and afterwards pin the resulting address in MPGR_MAINNET_DELEGATED_EXECUTOR. See docs/EXECUTOR-ARCHITECTURE-DECISION.md. UNIVERSAL TOKEN MODEL: the initial allowlist carries USDC, WETH, ALL 41 issued Coinbase B20 addresses (the 38 live stocks from lib/trade/tokenized-stocks.ts + COINc/CRCLc/INTCc which remain launch-pending per base/docs#1955), the official Coinbase wrapped assets from lib/markets/base-pairs.ts (cbBTC, cbETH, cbDOGE, cbXRP, cbLTC, cbADA) and cbZEC (official Coinbase announcement 2026-09-02, pinned in lib/markets/__tests__/base-pairs.test.ts). The 19 announced-not-live B20 addresses are deliberately EXCLUDED until Base lists them live: the immutable executor is universal by governance, not by construction - the Ownable2Step owner adds any future token at RUNTIME with setTokenAllowed(token,true) (one owner transaction; contract-existence and router/module conflict checks are built in; NO redeployment, NO address change), exactly as docs/EXECUTOR-ARCHITECTURE-DECISION.md sections 1 and 4 require. Adding a token to the on-chain allowlist does NOT by itself enable app routing: the TypeScript route table (lib/executor) and delegated runtime registry stay fail-closed until each pair is separately compatibility-verified. B20 security is address-first: ticker/name input is resolved through the canonical 60-entry catalog and every trade surface verifies the exact 0xb200 contract (lib/markets/base-pairs.ts verifyB20Address); look-alike or fake AAPLc/NVDAc contracts are never allowlisted here and are rejected as unlisted. Routers: BOTH production venues are allowlisted (see that doc section 7) - Aerodrome Slipstream for every USDC<->B20/wrapped-asset pair that has a live pool, and Uniswap V3 SwapRouter02 for USDC<->WETH; quotes remain fail-closed per pair (no pool or no liquidity = refused). Fee model is identical to v1: 25 bps, hard on-chain cap 100 bps, fee taken in the SELL token on every swap (BUY and SELL alike); there is no fee-bypass entrypoint. The executor includes the typed module registry, but it is intentionally empty at initial deployment; no venue module is pre-approved.

routers._note: Deliberately allowlisted HERE but NOT on the deployed v1 executor (its routerAllowlist is Slipstream-only). See docs/EXECUTOR-ARCHITECTURE-DECISION.md section 7: the TS mainnet route table declares this venue, so the delegated executor must accept it or autonomous USDC->WETH goals would revert RouterNotAllowed after the user signed.

denied._comment: Addresses that must NEVER appear as the deployer, owner, fee recipient, broadcaster, router or token in a mainnet delegated deployment. The canary wallet is the Phase 5 one-shot test wallet; the Sepolia entries are testnet contracts that must never be allowlisted on mainnet.

_typedModulesNote: The immutable core includes an owner-governed typed module registry. No modules are configured at initial deployment; a future module must be separately deployed per executor/router, code-reviewed, registered by governance and pinned by runtime bytecode hash. This is not a proxy/upgrade path.
